meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过腾讯官方 iLink Bot API 接入你的个人微信:用手机扫码登录,靠长轮询实时收消息,再由接好线的 agent 回复。不需要公网 webhook,也不需要付费 token。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加个人微信渠道、配置微信机器人扫码登录时触发;若在 /setup 流程中选择微信渠道也同样进入。

say.text: 帮我添加微信渠道,并给出扫码登录的二维码链接
把这个微信联系人接到我的 agent group 上
微信提示 session expired 了,怎么重新登录

howto.what_en: After install, Claude connects your personal WeChat through Tencent's official iLink Bot API: scan a QR code to log in, receive messages via long-polling, and reply through a wired agent group. No webhook URL and no paid token needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a personal WeChat channel to NanoClaw or set up WeChat bot QR login; picking the WeChat channel inside /setup also enters it.

say_en.text: Add the WeChat channel for me and give me the QR login link
say_en.note: After restart the logs print a QR URL, also saved to data/wechat/qr.txt

say_en.text: Wire this WeChat contact to my agent group
say_en.note: Run wire-dm.ts and pick the target agent group

say_en.text: WeChat says session expired, how do I log in again
say_en.note: Delete data/wechat/auth.json and restart to re-scan
